newsitem.title: CHINA: Tak Wing says held asset/stake sale talks.
newsitem.headline: Tak Wing says held asset/stake sale talks.

text.p: Tak Wing Investment (Holdings) Ltd said it had held preliminary talks with two third parties on the sale by Tak Wing of assets or a 10 percent stake in the company but the talks had been inconclusive.
Tak Wing said in a statement on Tuesday that it had also been approached by a financial intermediary which might have clients interested in discussing similar transactions.
The statement was made at the request of the stock exchange.
Trading in shares and warrants of Tak Wing was suspended on Friday and was due to resume on Tuesday. The stock last traded at HK$2.00.
